calculation.quarterly_month_eligibility: local_date is every 3 calendar months from 2026-12-20 (same day-of-month) in America/Phoenix
calculation.triennial_year_eligibility: local_date is every 3 years from 2027-01-01 and local time is within 00:00:00..23:59:59.999 America/Phoenix

exclusions: taxes or externally imposed fees unless separately configured
ui_rules: Each recurring promotion is active only for its specified full America/Phoenix local calendar day.
Resolve the commercial calendar in America/Phoenix.
Every Tuesday, only the 1-day pass receives the weekly promotion and it is 75% off for Basic, Researcher, and Enterprise.
On sale Saturdays every 14 days starting 2026-09-26, only the 1-week pass receives the Saturday promotion: Basic 50% off, Researcher 60% off, Enterprise 75% off.
Every 3 calendar months starting 2026-12-20, the 1-month pass is 45% off for Basic, Researcher, and Enterprise.
If two promotion schedules coincide, each applies only to its own duration; discounts do not stack on a single SKU.
The server computes promotion eligibility and price; clients may not submit authoritative discount eligibility or final price.

Every 3 years starting 2027-01-01, the 1-year pass is 50% off for Basic, Researcher, and Enterprise for exactly one 24-hour America/Phoenix calendar day.
For the triennial year-pass sale, order creation and first verified payment sighting must occur inside the 24-hour window; blockchain/payment confirmations may complete afterward.
If multiple promotion schedules coincide, each applies only to its own SKU duration; discounts never stack on one SKU.

saturday.non_sale_saturday_behavior: no Saturday recurring promotion; ordinary catalog/prices apply except any independently active quarterly month promotion

quarterly_month.rule: The 1-month pass is 45% off for all tiers on the full local calendar day every 3 months from 2026-12-20.

ordinary_days.rule: Outside active promotion windows, normal configured catalog/prices apply.

triennial_year.purchase_window_rule: Order must be created and first verified payment sighting must occur within the 24-hour sale window; confirmations may complete afterward.
triennial_year.rule: The 1-year pass is 50% off for all tiers for one 24-hour local calendar day every 3 years starting 2027-01-01.
